sources.label: IESNA RP-1 — Recommended Practice for Office Lighting: Illuminance Categories
sources.description: Provides recommended illumination levels: office general 300-500 lux, task areas 500-750 lux, lobbies/corridors 100-200 lux, parking 50-100 lux.

sources.label: ASHRAE 90.1 — Energy Standard for Buildings Except Low-Rise Residential (Lighting)
sources.description: Sets minimum light power density (LPD) requirements and references IES illuminance recommendations for lighting design.

sources.label: IESNA Lighting Handbook — Illuminance Recommendations by Space Type
sources.description: Comprehensive illumination recommendations: classrooms 300 lux, laboratories 500 lux, hospital wards 100 lux, OR 10,000-100,000 lux, retail 300-750 lux.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Minimum Lighting Requirements
sources.description: Minimum natural and artificial lighting requirements for habitable spaces as specified in the building code.
